messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — reseller partner is running a 72h EU promo May 12-14. They expect a burst of marketplace traffic. Can infra team surface GPU-hours + regional risk by EOD?
Shawn (Infra): Copy. Do we have an expected model list / sizes from the partner? that drives perf numbers.
Anna (Partnerships): They're pushing two SKUs: base-llama-13b and a quantized 13b-8bit variant. Partner marketing estimate = ~120k inference calls/day at peak EU region, avg 45 tokens per call.
Maria (SRE): Quick back-of-envelope: 120k calls/day -> ~1.39 calls/sec sustained over 24h, but promo spikes are bursty. Need peak RPS; partner gave a peak multiplier x6 for first 6 hours.
Liam (Sales): They said peak QPS ~8k during kickoff hour for EU storefront. not sustained.
Shawn (Infra): 8k qps is nontrivial. For base-llama-13b on our prod config, rough throughput = ~40 requests/sec per GPU with avg prompt/profile? that implies ~200 GPUs sustained for kickoff if no batching changes.
Maria (SRE): We can reduce cost by forcing the 8bit variant as a fallback and enabling aggressive batching for marketplace routes. If we route kickoff traffic to dedicated burst pool in eu-west-1 we can handle short spikes.
Anna (Partnerships): Reseller requires region constraint: traffic must stay in EU (eu-west-1 or eu-west-2). No us-east fallback allowed.
Shawn (Infra): That complicates things. Our eu pools have limited spare capacity. Options: 1) pre-warm reserved GPUs for May12 00:00 UTC; 2) enable cross-zone autoscale within EU (eu-west-1 <-> eu-west-2); 3) offer partner reduced throughput SLA and queue strategy.
Maria (SRE): My preference: pre-warm targeted GPUs + enable KV prefix cache warmers for partner prefixes to reduce per-request cost during kickoff. Also use model-variant fallback ordering: 13b-8bit -> 13b-4bit-quant -> base-13b.
Liam (Sales): Partner will accept graded degradation but wants a clear failover plan. They also asked for estimated cost delta compared to normal traffic.
Shawn (Infra): Rough cost calc: if we pre-warm 220 GPUs for 6 hours (kickoff window) then 220 * 6 GPU-hours = 1320 GPU-hours. For the remaining 66 hours of promo assume 40 GPUs steady -> 2640 GPU-hours. Total ~3960 GPU-hours for full 72h event in EU.
Maria (SRE): If we shift 60% of traffic to 8bit variant and batching reduces token rate by 30%, we can knock down total GPU-hours by ~28% -> ~2850 GPU-hours. Still need pre-warm plan.
Anna (Partnerships): Can we give partner two options in the quote: (A) Full SLA peak guarantee (pre-warm + dedicated burst) price X; (B) Cost-optimized with fallback (lower price, reduced SLA)?
Liam (Sales): Yes — we should price both. Also include an add-on for longer logs retention and per-route telemetry. Partner likely to pay for observability.
Shawn (Infra): Action items for infra: 1) check exact inventory in eu-west-1 & eu-west-2 and confirm max burstable GPUs by tomorrow 09:00 UTC; 2) draft pre-warm job (we can trigger node boot + model warmers 6h before kickoff); 3) add a policy to limit market-place routes to quantized variant during spikes.
Maria (SRE): I'll write a small runbook and a CLI snippet to trigger warmers. Example command:
```
# pre-warm script (demo)
redwood infra reserve --region eu-west-1 --count 220 --start 2026-05-11T22:00:00Z --duration 12h
redwood serve warm-prefix --route marketplace/reseller-abc --model 13b-8bit --concurrency 64
```
Shawn (Infra): Nice. Also need networking checklist: check peering bandwidth and LB limits for eu clusters. If we hit 8k qps we may saturate nginx workers unless we scale LB.
Anna (Partnerships): Partner legal flagged data residency (EU logs) and asked about cost split for pre-warm reserved capacity. They expect us to absorb some of the pre-warm cost or discount.
Liam (Sales): We'll propose a 50/50 pre-warm credit or a flat promo credit in contract. I'll coordinate with finance.
DeployBot: Scheduled task created: pre-warm-reseller-abc -> start=2026-05-11T22:00:00Z, GPUs=220, regions=[eu-west-1], owner=@Shawn (Infra).
Shawn (Infra): I'll run inventory check now and post numbers in this thread within the hour. If anyone has historical marketplace spike traces (particularly EU), drop them here.
Maria (SRE): Adding a short eval to ensure output quality for 8bit variant — don't want regressions during promo. Can run 1000 sample prompts against both variants.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks all. Partner call at 16:00 UTC — I'll bring options A/B and the pre-warm credit proposal. Please paste final GPU-hour numbers and runbook before 15:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
Shawn (Infra): will do.
Liam (Sales): I'll get finance on standby.
Maria (SRE): prepping evals now.
Anna (Partnerships): Appreciate it.
